entries.en: Whatever...

entries.speaker: Ohya

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Information about someone? [n]Cold hard cash?
Nothing really.
I'll let you know later.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: *chuckle* Lucky me! My very own[n]golden goose just appeared.

entries.speaker: Ohya

entries.speaker: Ohya

entries.speaker: Ohya

entries.speaker: Ohya

I support them.
The bad guys are bad.
Nothing fishy here.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Support the Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So you're being swayed by [n]the Phantom Thieves, huh?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You're a terrible liar...

entries.speaker: Ohya

entries.en: Don't tell me you're...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: And I'll write articles based on what you[n]tell me about them.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You know, the Phantom Thieves who you [n]love oh-so-much...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Deal?
Sounds great.
Write something good.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I will. I will. But the quality of the articles[n]will depend on the info you provide me.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...All right then. It's a deal.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I can create a lot of positive PR for the[n]Phantom Thieves, so be sure to give me[n]some good scoops.
I've made a deal with Ohya...

entries.speaker: Sae

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Did you have an inside man in the[n]media? Someone who could manipulate[n]information for you?

entries.speaker: Sae

entries.speaker: Igor

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Okay, Lala-chaaan! Time to celebrate[n]our agreement!

entries.speaker: Ohya

entries.speaker: Ohya

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Whoa, her silence is golden.

entries.speaker: Ohya

entries.speaker: Ohya

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
